name: ship-it
description: 🚢 One press raises a PR for the session's work, then watches CI and reviews and works through the feedback until it's ready to merge.

confirmOutward.title: Confirm before pushing and replying
confirmOutward.description: Claude asks before it commits and pushes, opens the PR, and posts its first replies on a PR.

pollSeconds.title: Check the PR every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often Ship It looks at the PR. It waits up to eight times longer while nothing changes.

maxRounds.title: Automatic rounds per PR
maxRounds.description: How many times Ship It hands new feedback to Claude before handing the PR back to you.

allowAutoMerge.title: Merge when ready
allowAutoMerge.description: Merge the PR once checks pass, reviews are approved and every thread is resolved.
